label: Optics
note: Shot sizes, angles, apertures, cinema bodies, and atmospheric air.

options.label: Close/Medium action lock (chest-to-hips crop, tight on contact)
options.rule: tight close and medium close-up framing: every shot stays cropped closely on the subjects' faces, torsos, hands and point of contact, filling 75 to 85 percent of the frame with the physical action.

options.label: 3/4 high-angle top-down (45–60° look-down, preserving face & depth)
options.rule: a steep three-quarter top-down high angle: the camera sits at a 45 to 60 degree angle above eye level looking down at the subject so their upturned face, throat, chest and body depth stay clear and expressive.

options.label: Occupied foreground edges (framed past blurred shoulder/doorframe)
options.rule: occupied-edge depth framing: one side edge of the frame is partially occupied by a softly blurred foreground doorframe, lamp or shoulder, leaving a clean open window in the center for the main subject.

options.label: 🔭 2x Anamorphic Cinema Prime (Vertical Oval Bokeh + Blue Horizontal Streak)
options.rule: shot on a 2x anamorphic cinema prime lens: wide cinematic field of view with creamy vertical oval bokeh highlights, subtle barrel edge breathing, and horizontal blue anamorphic light streaks.

options.label: 🔭 24mm Laowa Bug-Eye Macro Probe Lens (Extreme Close Detail + Wide Room Context)
options.rule: shot on a 24mm f/14 macro probe lens: inches away from the foreground skin or object in tack-sharp macro detail while keeping the wider room geometry visible in deep perspective behind.

options.label: 🔭 Vintage Helios 58mm f/2 (Swirly Cat's-Eye Bokeh + Warm Highlight Bloom)
options.rule: shot on a vintage Helios 58mm f/2 lens wide open: razor-sharp center subject surrounded by signature swirling cat's-eye background bokeh and warm vintage highlight bloom.

options.label: 🔭 Tilt-Shift Selective Focus Plane (Oblique Razor-Thin Focus Band)
options.rule: tilt-shift oblique focus plane: an angled slice of razor-sharp focus cuts across the subject's eyes and hands while the upper and lower frame melt into creamy blur.

options.label: 📐 Hip-Level Western / Action Stance Angle
options.rule: filmed from hip height: the lens sits at waist/hip level looking slightly up at the torso and face, giving every step, hip sway, or weapon draw commanding physical weight.

options.label: 📐 Pillow-Level Bedside Eye-to-Eye Intimate Angle
options.rule: filmed at pillow level resting right on the mattress: the lens sits eye-to-eye just inches from the subject's face on the bed with soft foreground sheet folds.

options.label: 🖼️ Mirror Dual-Plane Framing (Real Back in Foreground + Reflected Face in Glass)
options.rule: dual-plane mirror framing: the subject's real back and shoulders occupy the near foreground while their front torso and expressive face are framed clearly inside the mirror reflection ahead.

options.label: 🎭 Directive: Multi-Subject (S1–S9) Depth-Staggered Ensemble Blocking (Zero Face Occlusion)
options.rule: multi-subject depth-staggered blocking: arrange all cast subjects (<Subject 1> through <Subject N>) across distinct foreground, midground, and background X/Z coordinates so every single character's face and body remain 100% visible keeping every single face clearly visible and unobstructed.

options.label: ✨ Directive: Wet / Oiled Skin Micro-Specular & Subsurface Scattering Lock
options.rule: hyper-tactile skin rendering: crisp micro-specular highlights on beads of sweat, body oil, and glossy lips paired with warm red-orange subsurface scattering through ears, fingertips, and curves.

options.label: 📐 Extreme Ground-Level Sole & Stiletto Heel Worship Angle
options.rule: filmed flat on the floor just inches from the subject's bare soles, toes, or stiletto heels in the giant near foreground, tilting steeply up the full length of their legs toward their hips and towering face above.

options.label: 🔭 24mm f/1.4 Close-Intimacy Wide Prime (Immersive Near-Proximity Depth)
options.rule: filmed on a fast 24mm f/1.4 wide prime positioned within arm's reach of the subject, exaggerating front-to-back proximity and drawing the viewer right inside their personal space with creamy background falloff.

options.label: Anamorphic 2.39:1 Horizontal Cobalt Flare Streaks & Oval Bokeh
options.rule: Shot on vintage Panavision C-Series anamorphic glass producing crisp horizontal cobalt-blue streak flares from bright speculars and lush vertical oval background bokeh.

options.label: 100mm Macro Lens (Razor-Thin Eyelash, Pore & Droplet Depth)
options.rule: Shot on a 100mm macro cinema lens with razor-thin millimeter focus catching individual eyelashes, iris fibers, glistening skin texture, and slow-falling micro droplets.

options.label: 200mm Telephoto Compressed Air Heat Haze Shimmer
options.rule: 200mm telephoto compression slicing through rising radiant heat shimmer waves that softly ripple distant rooflines, flames, or asphalt lights behind sharp foreground figures.

options.label: Chilly Night Air Visible Breath Vapor & Drifting Mist
options.rule: Crisp cool night air revealing pale billowing breath vapor escaping parted lips on every exhale alongside drifting low atmospheric mist.

options.label: Golden Window Sunbeam Shafts With Floating Dust Motes
options.rule: Diagonal dusty golden sunbeams slicing cleanly through shaded room air with dozens of shimmering airborne dust motes drifting across light shafts.

options.label: Dancing Turquoise Pool Water Caustics Across Skin & Walls
options.rule: Refracted liquid turquoise pool caustic ribbons dancing steadily upward across bare skin, tiled walls, and glass ceilings in soothing shimmering waves.

options.label: 🎥 Arri Alexa LF Digital Cinema (Wide Dynamic Range & Filmic Rolloff)
options.rule: Shot on Arri Alexa LF large-format digital cinema camera with lush natural skin tones, gentle highlight rolloff, and rich shadow latitude.

options.label: 🎥 Sony Venice 2 Low-Light Cinema (Clean Night Shadow Clarity)
options.rule: Shot on Sony Venice 2 full-frame dual-ISO cinema camera delivering ultra-clean nocturnal shadow texture and razor-sharp practical neon response.

options.label: 🎥 Panavision Millennium DXL2 (Warm Classic Hollywood Skin)
options.rule: Shot on Panavision Millennium DXL2 with warm, flattering Hollywood skin rendition, organic contrast, and creamy focus falloff.

options.label: 📸 Polaroid SX-70 Instant Film (Dreamy Pastel Borders & Soft Fade)
options.rule: Polaroid SX-70 instant analog film aesthetic with creamy pastel fade, gentle optical softness, warm flash falloff, and classic instant-film borders.

options.label: 🔭 f/1.2 Razor-Thin Dreamy Bokeh
options.rule: Wide-open f/1.2 aperture yielding razor-thin focus strictly on the eyelashes while melting the foreground and background into creamy painterly bokeh.

options.label: 🔭 f/2.8 Cinema Primes (Balanced Subject & Set Separation)
options.rule: Crisp cinema f/2.8 aperture balancing sharp facial/garment clarity across two subjects with smooth, natural background separation.

options.label: 🔭 f/16 Crisp Deep Focus & Optical Sunstars
options.rule: Stopped-down f/16 deep architectural focus keeping foreground props and distant horizons tack-sharp simultaneously with crisp optical sunstars around bright bulbs.

options.label: 🎞️ Analog Film Burn & Warm Edge Halation Leaks
options.rule: Organic 35mm celluloid film burn streaks and warm amber-crimson sprocket edge light leaks washing intermittently across frame edges.

options.label: Extreme Close-Up (Eyes & Lips)
options.rule: tight extreme close-up filling the frame with eyes, lashes, and lips

options.rule: 200mm extreme telephoto lens flattening distant urban or landscape planes into tight layered ribbons with subtle atmospheric air shimmer

options.rule: vintage cinema prime optics yielding creamy highlight rolloff, soft skin rendering, subtle warm amber halation around lamps, and gently rolling outer bokeh

options.label: ⚡ Low Shutter Staccato (Crisp Frozen Droplets & Sharp Action Edges)
options.rule: crisp narrow-shutter staccato motion cadence freezing splashing droplets, flying dust, and fast limb snaps with razor-sharp edge clarity in every frame

options.rule: balanced golden-ratio placement giving generous open breathing room across the direction the subject looks or walks

options.rule: dry matte natural human skin texture with crisp visible pores across nose bridge and cheeks, fine peach-fuzz vellus hairs along jawline and forearms, subtle knuckle and lip micro-creases, authentic uneven capillary undertones, and dry tactile cloth fibers

options.label: 🎥 Ultra-Realism 50mm Raw Prime (Micro-Contrast & Shadow Latitude)
options.rule: Shot on a sharp 50mm cinema prime lens at f/2.8 with honest edge-to-edge optical resolution, crisp micro-contrast, deep neutral shadow toe, gentle unclipped highlight rolloff, and natural depth falloff
